parameters.content:
Sunday 6pm. One short, plain-words message per family with a link straight to the child's screen.
Only students with written guardian consent. Only verified marks. No ratings, no cohort numbers.

parameters.query:
SELECT st.student_id, split_part(st.full_name, ' ', 1) AS first_name, g.phone,
       ROUND(cp.covered * 100) AS covered_pct, ROUND(alcovia.syllabus_plan(CURRENT_DATE) * 100) AS plan_pct,
       att.attended, att.held, ue.subject, ue.exam_date
FROM alcovia.students st
JOIN alcovia.guardians g ON g.student_id = st.student_id AND g.consent_at IS NOT NULL
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage >= 2)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS covered
                    FROM alcovia.student_chapter_progress WHERE student_id = st.student_id) cp
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.attended) AS attended, COUNT(*) AS held
                    FROM alcovia.event_attendance a JOIN alcovia.program_events e USING (event_id)
                    WHERE a.student_id = st.student_id AND e.held AND e.scheduled_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND e.scheduled_at <= now()) att
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sub.name AS subject, u.exam_date FROM alcovia.upcoming_exams u JOIN alcovia.subjects sub USING (subject_id)
                   WHERE u.student_id = st.student_id AND u.exam_date >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY u.exam_date LIMIT 1) ue ON true;
